senses.definition: (uncountable, Canada, US) Spinning or rotary motion given to a ball around the vertical axis, as in pool, billiards or bowling; spin, sidespin.
examples: You can't hit it directly, but maybe if you give it some english.

quotes.text: There was a magical way of putting English on the dice to result in a six.

quotes.text: Some drop science, while I'm dropping english.
